title: Motion tokens with ease-out defaults and a reduced-motion kill switch
context: application-spa-REQ-012 requires tokenised motion. The duration range, easing family, and the reduced-motion mechanism need one recorded answer inside the SPA.
decision: Motion durations and easings come from the motion tokens (fast 150ms, base 200ms, slow 250ms; ease-out family) in the token file. prefers-reduced-motion collapses non-essential transitions to none via one root-level media rule, not per-component checks.
consequences: Motion is consistent and disableable in one place. Choreographed long-form animation is out of the blueprint's scope and would need its own decision.
